description: Remind the workers who have not acknowledged one Read Required release of a job (job_instructions.compliance.remind). Sends the existing in-app reminder: it names the job, says its Instructions need reading and links to them (no free text). Each worker gets at most one reminder per release — a repeat by anyone answers ALREADY_REMINDED for that worker and sends nothing; a newer release allows a new reminder. Every handled worker gets a row: REMINDED, ALREADY_REMINDED, ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED, NOT_REQUIRED, NOT_ON_JOB (left or ended), ACCOUNT_INACTIVE (banned or closed) or FAILED (nothing recorded; retry with a new idempotencyKey). releaseId comes from the job’s releases (a READ_REQUIRED release of the job or its folder). Without workerUserIds it handles 100 workers per call: follow nextCursor. idempotencyKey is required; a retry with it replays the stored result. Employer-only and gated by the Read Required rollout (outside it: 404). Requires instructions:write.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_compliance_remind
